label: H.R. 10619
title: Spending Safeguard Act

items.snippet: This bill requires the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) to establish spending limits for certain direct spending programs that (1) are enacted or reauthorized after…
The spending limits must be equal to (1) 120% of the cost of the program for defense, health, income security, or veterans benefits and services programs;
The bill excludes Medicare and Social Security from the spending limits.
OMB and the President must submit specified reports to Congress comparing current spending to the limits.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.amount_note: Amounts are the income or expenses reported on the whole LD-2 filing, not money spent on this bill.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

F000450.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
F000450.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
F000450.note: None of the lobbying clients on this bill matched an industry rule, so there is nothing to compare.
